versions.statuteQuote: Agrees to the exculpation or limitation of any liability of the landlord to the tenant arising under law or to indemnify the landlord for that liability or any associated costs

summaryForModel: A lease cannot release or limit the landlord's legal liability to the tenant, or make the tenant indemnify the landlord for that liability or its costs. Such a clause is unenforceable.
paraphraseExamples: Landlord shall not be liable for any injury or damage to Tenant or Tenant's property, however caused.
Tenant agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Landlord from all claims, including those caused by Landlord's negligence.
Owner is not responsible for losses from leaks, mold, or failure of building systems.
tenantExplanation: A lease can't excuse your landlord from responsibility the law puts on them, or make you cover their costs for it. This clause can't be enforced.
action: You can ask your landlord to remove this clause or limit it to damage you cause.
